title: Core: Symbol linkage export and importForRuntimeSharing
description: Unit tests for symbol linkage in SWF export. A Symbol with linkage.exportForActionScript=true and linkage.linkageIdentifier='MyClip' should appear in the SWF ExportAssets tag (type 56). A symbol with importForRuntimeSharing=true should generate ImportAssets tags. Tests in packages/swf/src/__tests__/symbolexport.test.ts.
